public_content.question: What is the o1sf program?
public_content.short_answer: o1sf is an intensive three-week program for founders entering or expanding in the U.S. market.
public_content.detailed_answer: It combines two online preparation weeks with one in-person week in San Francisco. Founders test the market, improve business assets, meet relevant people, and build a practical U.S. action plan.
